scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.docs:api: npx --yes documentation@14.0.0 build src/index.js --document-exported --github -f md -o docs/reference/api.md
scripts.docs:architecture: mkdir -p docs/public/generated && npx --yes dependency-cruiser@18.1.0 src --config .dependency-cruiser.mjs --output-type html --output-to docs/public/generated/dependencies.html
scripts.docs:generate: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:architecture && npm run docs:db
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generate && npx --yes vitepress@1.6.4 build docs
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:generate && npx --yes vitepress@1.6.4 dev docs
